rejected.label: Osteitis Fibrosa Cystica
rejected.why: While the patient has bone lesions, the presence of a large tumor and specific laboratory findings point more towards a brown tumor secondary to primary hyperparathyroidism due to parathyroid carcinoma.

rejected.label: Primary Hyperparathyroidism
rejected.why: This is a broader condition that the champion diagnosis is a specific complication of, making the champion more specific and evidence-supported.
